policy_basis.current_allowed_scope: Draft this source/cache plan only. No source requests, HEAD/Range calls, dataset or model downloads, panel acceptance, fitting/tuning/scoring, future holdout forecast capture, outcome release or P&L.

intent: Specify source-specific candidate acquisitions and cache policy for a future independently gated PPR4 source sample. This file is a proposal only; requested=false and bytes_downloaded=0 for every source.

wave1.name: CORE INDEX/SESSION/SCHEMA PILOT
wave1.purpose: Only after separate tester approval; validate official index-source mechanics, calendar and a single recent-volatility alternate without accepting a modeling panel.
wave1.user_agent: Project contact user-agent to be reviewed; no authentication by default

wave2.name: FREE MACRO/GLOBAL SAMPLE
wave2.purpose: Only after a fresh tester gate; one provider response per source, small sample and exact direct URLs.

wave3.name: OPTIONS AND CORPORATE ACTION METADATA/SAMPLE
wave3.purpose: Only after license, point-in-time and exact archive URL review; large HF datasets remain metadata-only.

global_constraints.cache_layout: data/cache/<source_id>/<source_revision_or_date>/<normalized_query_hash>/raw.* plus manifest.json; a cache hit is valid only if source, revision, schema, date range, checksum, license and PIT metadata match
global_constraints.rate_limit: Serial requests only. One request per approved source in each approved wave. No automatic retry/backoff loop; failures are logged and stop that source.
global_constraints.max_caps_note: Wave caps are per approved source sample only; they are not permission for full-history ingestion or model-panel acceptance.
